question: Agriculture and fishing activities belong to which sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Primary sector.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Products and services are produced as a result of economic activity, and sectors are collections of economic activities categorised according to certain standards.
 
• Based on ownership, labour conditions, and the type of activity, the Indian economy can be divided into several sectors.
 
• **Economic sector types according to the type of activity:**
 
 
• **Primary Sector**
 
• **Secondary Sector**
 
• **Tertiary Sector**
 
• **Quaternary Sector**
 
 
 
• **Primary Sector**:
 
 
• Activities in the primary sector of the economy involve the direct use of natural resources.
 
• Some examples of this industry are agriculture, mining, fishing, forestry, dairy, and so on.
 
• It is thus named because it serves as the foundation for all other goods.
 
• It is also known as the "agriculture and allied sector" because the majority of the natural products we use come from forestry, fishery, dairy, and agriculture.
 
• Because primary activities require working outside, those who engage in them are referred to as red-collar workers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Secondary Sector:**

 
 
• It encompasses the sectors in which natural resources generated in the primary sector are used to create final goods.
 
• This sector includes operations such as sugar cane production, cotton fabric production, and industrial production.
 
• Therefore, manufacturing is the sector of a nation's economy that produces goods as opposed to raw materials.
 
• This sector is also known as the industrial sector because it is connected to several industries.
 
• Blue collar workers are those who perform auxiliary tasks. 
 
 
 
• **Tertiary Sector:**
 
 
• The primary and secondary sectors benefit from the activity of this sector.
 
• Economic activity in the tertiary sector assists or supports production rather than producing commodities on its own.
 
• It is also known as Service Sector.
 
• The industry includes things like banking, insurance, finance, and truck or train-borne freight.
 
• It adds value to a product in the same way as the secondary sector.
 
• White collar jobs are those in this industry.
 
 
 
• **Economic sector types depending on labour conditions:**
 
 
• **Organised Sector**
 
• **Unorganised Sector**
 
 
 
• **Organised Sector:**
 
 
• Employees in this industry are guaranteed employment and social security, and job terms are regular and set.
 
• It may also be described as an industry that is registered with the government and to which certain acts are applicable to the businesses.
 
• The organized sector includes hospitals and schools.
 
• Employees in the organized industry are guaranteed a job. They have a set amount of hours that they are required to work. The company must give them extra pay if they put in more hours.
